**3. Accrue unpaid payroll — posted, pending approval (checklist: in_progress)**
- JE-00306 (3/31): Dr 6000 18,600.00, Dr 6010 1,422.90 / Cr 2150 **20,022.90**, supported by the approved hourly support staff pre-register (DOC-0204; work period 3/22–3/31, pays 4/3).
- Confirmed no overlap with the 3/15 and 3/30 salaried runs, and 2150 had no prior activity.
- Because the entry exceeds the USD 10,000 posting threshold, I routed it to you via `request_approval` immediately after posting (single entry, not split). Please mark the checklist item complete once approved.

No exceptions were needed — every entry had clean documentary support. One follow-up noted in the memo: when the 4/3 hourly payroll clears the payroll account, it should relieve 2150 rather than re-expense the wages.
